elective_model.core: mandatory within owning cohort; core count can be overridden per cohort
elective_model.cross_cohort_core_electives: a configurable fraction of each cohort's core subjects is offered to other cohorts in the same semester
elective_model.department_electives: shared by programmes within the owning department
elective_model.cross_department_open_electives: a configurable fraction of department electives is offered to other departments
elective_model.common_courses: shared across departments within the same programme and semester; distinct between programmes
